title: Future Juice Strawberry Kiwi & Watermelon 10ml E-Liquid
description: Strawberry Kiwi and Watermelon by Future Juice is a lively fruit blend that brings together three distinct flavours for a dynamic all-day vape. Juicy Strawberry forms the base with its bright, summery sweetness, while Kiwi introduces a vibrant tropical tang that adds a delightful contrast. Watermelon rounds out the profile with a fresh, delicately sweet finish that lifts the whole experience. Each puff delivers a smooth and flavourful fruit mix that balances sweet and sharp notes to perfection. This e-liquid uses nicotine salts to provide a silky-smooth, yet tactile throat hit and rapid nicotine relief. Blended at a 50VG/50PG ratio, it's designed for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping, making it ideal for use in refillable pod vape kits , vape pens , and vape starter kits . Future Juice Nic Salts are available in 5mg, 10mg and 20mg strengths, allowing vapers to tailor their nicotine intake to suit their needs. Created by UK-based e-liquid specialists Future Juice, this Nic Salt range delivers vibrant flavours that truly come alive in modern vape devices, for consistent satisfaction in every bottle.
